comment: Admission policy for rule candidates. Every number here is a documented starting point; thresholds for performance are calibrated by scripts/bench.py against the last approved set, not fixed percentages.

regex.comment: risk score adds points for nested quantifiers, unbounded .* or .+ runs and very wide {n,m} gaps; a high score only sends the rule to quarantine, the dynamic benchmark decides if it is really slow

absolute.comment: sanity limits used when there is no previous release to compare with; generous on purpose, calibrated from the first real release

required_platforms.independent-macos-vm: not-available: hosted macOS runners are VMs without nested virtualization (hv_vmm_present=1, no Hypervisor.framework); needs a self-hosted bare-metal Mac
